R. Q. 2 تَدَأْدَأَ : see above. ―
-b2- Also It (a stone, TA) rolled; or rolled along or down: (K, TA:) it (anything) rolled, or rolled along or down, before one, (M, TA,) and went away: IAth says that it may be from تَدَهْدَهَ. (TA.) ―
-b3- It became, or was put, in motion. (TA.) ―
-b4- And, contr., It became, or was rendered, still, or motionless. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
